When the NPU is configured and started, it autonomously fetches data from the external
memory to feed its internal dynamically interconnected processing units. Similarly, the result
of the operation sequence is flushed to the external memory.
Inputs/sources can be the activations/features, but also parameters, such as weights and
biases constant data hosted in a memory-mapped nonvolatile memory. When the data-
stream processing pipes are configured and started, the settings cannot be modified until
the end-of-transfer event notifications of all DMA-outs and sinks.
